excerpts.text: A route is an ordered list of stops. A label names one stop. A tag groups stops by a shared feature. Changing a label does not change the route order. Rearranging stops changes the route order. Two stops may share a tag while retaining different labels.

entries.title: Routes, labels and tags
entries.scope: Invented structural fixture. No real course materials or student trial were processed.

blocks.text: A route records order, a label identifies a stop, and a tag groups stops by a feature. Keep these three jobs distinct when describing a change.

Renaming a stop changes how it is named while preserving its place in the route. Moving a stop changes the order. Tags address a different question: which stops share a feature? Thus two differently named stops can share a tag without becoming the same label.

blocks.prompt: Hypothetical route: North then South. Both stops have the tag quiet. Rename North to Oak without moving it. State the resulting order and whether sharing quiet makes the two stop labels identical.
blocks.answer: Oak then South. Their labels remain different despite the shared tag.
blocks.rationale: Renaming changes a label, not position, so the first stop is still first. A tag groups stops by feature; the handout explicitly permits shared tags with different labels. Confusing a shared tag with a shared label would erase this distinction.

items: Memorize: route = ordered stops; label = stop name; tag = shared feature.
Understand: identifying what changed requires distinguishing a new name from a new position.

requirements.text: Study objective: Distinguish route order, labels and tags.

objectives.title: Study objective: Distinguish route order, labels and tags.
freeRecallCues: Without notes, explain the distinct jobs of route, label and tag.
understand: A route specifies an order of stops.
A label names an individual stop.
A tag groups stops through a shared feature.
Renaming a stop preserves its route position.
Stops sharing a tag can still have different labels.
beAbleToDo: Predict route order after a rename with no movement.
Distinguish a shared tag from identical stop labels in a supplied example.
watchFor: Do not treat a shared tag as proof that two labels are identical.
